- load_cell_excitation_voltage: two options: 5 V DC or 10 V DC → config axis could be excitation voltage option. So a config axis "load_cell_excitation_voltage" with conditions "5 V DC" and "10 V DC", attributes: minimum_input_voltage_per_verification_scale_interval, load_cell_excitation_voltage.

Hmm. Let me structure:
